import json,re,os
root="/Users/wahrfreiheit/OMP/hungary-socialist-mechanism-lab"; os.chdir(root)
base="config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/"
cert=json.load(open(base+"BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json",encoding="utf-8"))
rep=open(base+"REPORT.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
ct=json.dumps(cert,ensure_ascii=False)

# Classify every attempt-adjacent terminal-word occurrence: must be a NEGATION or a POINTER (no attempt named as writer)
NEG=["no attempt is named","No attempt is designated","not attributed to any single attempt",
     "not the last one","superseded by later rounds","不是任何单次尝试的写盘时刻"]
PTR=["EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json","commands.json","model_usage.json"]
print("--- CERT attempt-adjacent terminal occurrences ---")
for m in re.finditer(r"attempt[^\"]{0,110}", ct):
    seg=m.group(0)
    if re.search(r"\b(current|last|final)\b|当前|最后|最终", seg):
        kind = "NEGATION" if any(k in seg for k in NEG) else ("POINTER" if any(k in seg for k in PTR) else "UNCLASSIFIED")
        print(f"  [{kind}] {seg[:130]}")
print("\n--- REPORT attempt-adjacent terminal occurrences ---")
for m in re.finditer(r"attempt[^\n\"]{0,110}", rep):
    seg=m.group(0)
    if re.search(r"\b(current|last|final)\b|当前|最后|最终", seg):
        kind = "NEGATION" if any(k in seg for k in NEG) else ("POINTER" if any(k in seg for k in PTR) else "UNCLASSIFIED")
        print(f"  [{kind}] {seg[:130]}")
# hard rule: no "attempt-N" directly followed by terminal adjective naming it as writer
bad=[]
for m in re.finditer(r"attempt-?\d[^,;。\n]{0,40}(?:is|as)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:current|last|final)", ct+"\n"+rep):
    bad.append(m.group(0)[:90])
print("\npatterns naming an attempt AS current/last/final:", bad if bad else "NONE")
